added_features.momentum_sign_agreement: Mean sign of causal returns at 1,3,6,12 bars.
added_features.trend_sign_agreement: Mean sign across causal SMA/EMA price ratios at 5,10,20 bars.
added_features.trend_strength_mean_abs: Mean absolute causal SMA/EMA price ratio.
added_features.trend_momentum_agreement: Product of signs of mean trend ratios and mean momentum returns.
added_features.volatility_5_to_20: Causal 5-bar volatility divided by 20-bar volatility; zero if denominator is zero.
added_features.volatility_10_to_20: Causal 10-bar volatility divided by 20-bar volatility; zero if denominator is zero.
added_features.body_to_range: Causal candle body divided by candle range; zero if denominator is zero.
added_features.wick_imbalance_to_range: Upper minus lower wick divided by candle range.
added_features.total_wick_to_range: Upper plus lower wick divided by candle range.
added_features.session_position: Minutes since open divided by minutes since open plus minutes until close.

causality: Each derived feature uses only same-row original causal features. No future row, future return, target, or volume field is input. Training dataset contains no volume or raw open/high/low columns, so no volume-derived feature was added.
